description: Header file defining interfaces and data structures for managing extension modules in a WiFi layer, including registration, unregistration, data handling, and cleanup functions.

classes.name: wld_extMod_dataList_t
classes.description: Data structure for managing a list of extension module data, containing a linked list.

methods.name: wld_extMod_register
methods.description: Registers a new extension module with vendor and module names, returning a module index.

methods.name: wld_extMod_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an extension module by its index.

methods.name: wld_extMod_isValidId
methods.description: Checks if an extension module ID is currently registered.

methods.name: wld_extMod_initDataList
methods.description: Initializes a data list for extension modules.

methods.name: wld_extMod_registerData
methods.description: Registers data for a specific extension module within a data list.

methods.name: wld_extMod_getData
methods.description: Retrieves registered data for a given extension module ID.

methods.name: wld_extMod_unregisterData
methods.description: Unregisters data for a specific extension module ID.

methods.name: wld_extMod_cleanupDataList
methods.description: Cleans up all extension module data in a list, calling delete handlers.
